diagrams.name: user_registration_and_login
diagrams.title: User Registration and Login Flow
diagrams.description: User registers an account or logs in; includes credential validation, session creation, and registration confirmation email

diagrams.name: shopping_cart_management
diagrams.title: Shopping Cart Management Flow
diagrams.description: Customer adds, updates quantity, or removes a product in the cart; cart state is persisted via CartServiceImpl and DBUtil

diagrams.name: checkout_and_payment
diagrams.title: Checkout and Payment Processing Flow
diagrams.description: Customer checks out; OrderServlet orchestrates order creation, transaction recording, ID generation, and payment-success email

diagrams.name: order_shipment
diagrams.title: Order Shipment Flow
diagrams.description: Admin ships an order; ShipmentServlet triggers shipment status update and sends an order-shipped notification email to the customer

diagrams.name: product_management_admin
diagrams.title: Admin Product Management Flow
diagrams.description: Admin adds or updates a product (with or without image); ProductServiceImpl persists to DB and ShowImage serves product images

diagrams.name: product_demand_and_notification
diagrams.title: Product Demand and Availability Notification Flow
diagrams.description: Customer registers demand for an out-of-stock product; when the product becomes available FansMessage triggers a notification email via DemandServiceImpl and MailMessage
